summary: The main article describes the optimization of a photocatalytic C-alkylation reaction using a 3D-printed reactor, featuring 3 tables for condition screening and DoE results, and 5 schemes detailing mechanisms and synthesis. The article also includes characterization data for 4 new products.

items.heading: Figure 1
items.caption: (A) Structure of 4CzIPN, (B) this work: photocatalyzed C -C bond forming reaction of the CH-acidic methyl cyanoacetate with 1,1diphenylethylene.
items.description: Shows the chemical structure of the 4CzIPN photocatalyst and the general reaction scheme for the C-C bond formation studied.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: Mechanochemical Synthesis of 4CzIPN
items.description: Illustrates the solvent-minimized mechanochemical synthesis of the 4CzIPN catalyst from carbazole and tetrafluoroisophthalonitrile.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.caption: C -C Bond Forming Reaction between Dimethyl Malonate (3) and 1,1-Diphenylethylene (4)
items.description: Depicts the model reaction used to investigate the optimal reaction atmosphere.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: Proposed Mechanism of the C -C Bond Formation Reaction and the Potential Side-Reaction Giving the De Mayo Product
items.description: Detailed catalytic cycle showing the formation of radicals and the competing De Mayo side-reaction pathway.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Yields of Reactions Conducted under Different Atmospheres
items.description: Comparison of reaction yields under argon bubbling, Schlenk techniques, and air to determine the effect of oxygen.

items.heading: Scheme 4
items.caption: C -C Bond Forming Reactions with New CHAcidic Substrates 6a -e
items.description: Shows the scope of different CH-acidic substrates tested in the photocatalytic coupling reaction.

items.heading: Table 2
items.caption: Results of Reactions between Diphenylethylene and CH-Acidic Substrates 6a -e
items.description: Lists the isolated yields and product types (C-C coupled vs De Mayo) for various substrates.

items.heading: Scheme 5
items.caption: Control Experiments
items.description: Shows experiments conducted without light or without catalyst to confirm the photocatalytic nature of the reaction.

items.heading: Table 3
items.caption: Results of the Initial Parameter Screening for Solvents and Bases
items.description: Extensive screening of various solvents and bases to identify the most effective combination for the reaction.

items.heading: Figure 2
items.caption: Results of the initial parameter screening for the determination of the reaction time
items.description: Graph showing the yield of the reaction over time to determine the optimal 5-hour duration.

items.heading: Table 5
items.caption: Experimental Design Matrix and Observed 7d Yields
items.description: The 2^4 full factorial design matrix showing the combinations of temperature, base, catalyst, and molar ratio tested.

items.heading: Figure 3
items.caption: Pareto Chart of the effects in the case of yield ( 7d ) as the dependent variable.
items.description: Statistical chart identifying temperature and molar ratio as the most significant factors affecting the yield.

items.heading: Figure 4
items.caption: Response surface plot for the effects of the temperature ( A ) and the molar ratio ( D ) at 4 mol % base and 2 mol % catalyst.
items.description: 3D plot showing the interaction between temperature and molar ratio on the reaction yield.

items.heading: Figure 5
items.caption: Observed and predicted 7d yields for the optimization experiments
items.description: Comparison of experimental yields versus model predictions during the gradient descent optimization steps.

items.heading: Figure 6
items.caption: Photoflow execution of the reaction of methyl cyanoacetate ( 6d ) and 1,1-diphenylethylene ( 4 ).
items.description: Schematic representation of the continuous flow setup using the 3D-printed reactor insert.

items.heading: 7a
items.caption: Dibenzyl 2(2,2-diphenylethyl)malonate
items.description: Characterization data for product 7a, including HRMS and NMR data.

items.heading: 8b
items.caption: 3,3-Diphenylheptane-2,6-dione
items.description: Characterization data for the De Mayo product 8b.

items.heading: 8c
items.caption: Ethyl 5-Oxo-4,4-diphenylhexanoate
items.description: Characterization data for the De Mayo product 8c.

items.heading: 7d
items.caption: Methyl 2-Cyano-4,4-diphenylbutanoate
items.description: Characterization data for the optimized C-C coupled product 7d.
